question: Do salaries differ across job role categories?
H0: All role categories have the same salary distribution
detail: highest median: Senior Management (15.00 lakh); lowest median: Other (2.50 lakh)
interpretation: Reject H0 at alpha=0.05 (p < 0.001, Holm-adjusted p < 0.001); effect size epsilon_sq = 0.238 (large). highest median: Senior Management (15.00 lakh); lowest median: Other (2.50 lakh).

question: Do IT-Software postings pay differently from other industries?
H0: Salary distributions of IT-Software and other industries are identical
detail: median IT-Software 5.00 vs others 3.25 lakh; bootstrap 95% CI of median difference [1.25, 2.25]
interpretation: Reject H0 at alpha=0.05 (p < 0.001, Holm-adjusted p < 0.001); effect size cliffs_delta = 0.325 (small). median IT-Software 5.00 vs others 3.25 lakh; bootstrap 95% CI of median difference [1.25, 2.25].

question: Is higher required experience associated with higher salary?
H0: No monotonic association between experience and salary (rho = 0)
detail: rank-based, so robust to the skewed salary distribution
interpretation: Reject H0 at alpha=0.05 (p < 0.001, Holm-adjusted p < 0.001); effect size spearman_rho = 0.724 (large). rank-based, so robust to the skewed salary distribution.

question: Do salaries differ between the main cities?
H0: All cities have the same salary distribution
test: Kruskal-Wallis (Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Chennai, Hyderabad, Mumbai)
detail: medians (lakh): Bengaluru 3.75, Delhi NCR 3.50, Chennai 3.25, Hyderabad 3.50, Mumbai 4.06. Cities differ in role/experience mix, so this is not a pure city effect.
interpretation: Reject H0 at alpha=0.05 (p < 0.001, Holm-adjusted p < 0.001); effect size epsilon_sq = 0.007 (negligible). medians (lakh): Bengaluru 3.75, Delhi NCR 3.50, Chennai 3.25, Hyderabad 3.50, Mumbai 4.06. Cities differ in role/experience mix, so this is not a pure city effect.

question: Does the mix of job roles depend on the city?
H0: Role category and city are independent
test: Chi-square test of independence (top 8 roles x top 4 cities)
detail: dof=21; smallest expected cell count = 34.6 (assumption OK)
interpretation: Reject H0 at alpha=0.05 (p < 0.001, Holm-adjusted p < 0.001); effect size cramers_v = 0.145 (small). dof=21; smallest expected cell count = 34.6 (assumption OK).

question: Are fresher-friendly postings more (or less) likely to disclose pay? (SDG 8 transparency)
H0: Salary-disclosure rate is the same for fresher-open and experience-only postings
interpretation: Reject H0 at alpha=0.05 (p < 0.001, Holm-adjusted p < 0.001); effect size cohens_h = 0.776 (medium). disclosure rate: fresher-open 60.7% vs experience-required 23.5%.

question: Do Programming & Design roles ask for more experience than Voice (BPO) roles?
detail: median required experience: Programming 5.0 vs Voice 2.5 years
interpretation: Reject H0 at alpha=0.05 (p < 0.001, Holm-adjusted p < 0.001); effect size cliffs_delta = 0.683 (large). median required experience: Programming 5.0 vs Voice 2.5 years.
